ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.

2. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

3. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

7. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

8. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.

9. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.

10. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

11. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

12. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

15. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain DC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Wiring Systems and Regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
